dx_friction: Auth is a single Bearer token; the whole read surface is one documented OpenAPI spec served from the space itself, so endpoints are discoverable without trial-and-error. Spans come back as flat OpenInference/OTel attribute maps with W3C ids — traces are reconstructed client-side by grouping on context.trace_id (an include_spans=true option exists on the traces endpoint). Filters are deliberately simple (time, name, span_kind, attribute key:value); anything analytical must be done client-side. Malformed start_time returned HTTP 422 with a structured validation body naming the bad parameter.
